patterns.note: Full-width content sections with distinct background colors (black, white, red) create clear visual breaks and guide the user through the page.
Headings are set in a large, bold, sans-serif typeface, often in all caps, providing strong visual hierarchy and impact against a contrasting background.
A high-contrast color scheme of black and white is consistently used, punctuated by a vibrant red for key accents, call-to-action buttons, and brand elements.
Sections of content dynamically reveal themselves with a subtle slide-up or fade-in animation as they enter the viewport during scrolling.
The main navigation bar transitions to a sticky, fixed position at the top of the screen after the user scrolls past the initial hero section, maintaining accessibility.
The hero section features a full-bleed video background that plays silently, creating a dynamic and immersive introduction to the site's content.

technique_notes: The site utilizes a scroll-triggered animation system, likely enhanced by `locomotive-scroll` as hinted, to progressively reveal content. As the user scrolls down, entire sections or individual elements within them animate into view with a smooth slide-up or fade-in effect, creating a sense of discovery and engagement.
A full-screen video loop is embedded as the background of the hero section, playing automatically and silently to provide dynamic visual interest without distracting from the overlaid text content.

The primary navigation bar is designed to initially appear at the top of the page and then transition into a fixed, sticky header once the user scrolls beyond the hero content, ensuring navigation remains accessible at all times.

design_tokens.type_scale: Large, bold, often uppercase headings (~3-4x body) provide strong visual impact, complemented by clear and legible body text.
design_tokens.radius: Sharp corners are used consistently across all elements, contributing to a clean and modern aesthetic.
design_tokens.spacing: Balanced to airy, with generous vertical padding between major sections and a more compact, grid-based arrangement for content within sections.

standout: This site's design is distinctive for its authoritative and modern feel, achieved through a stark, high-contrast palette of black, white, and a powerful red accent. The dynamic video hero combined with subtle, scroll-triggered content reveals creates an engaging and premium user experience that feels both innovative and established, setting it apart from typical corporate sites.
